title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1969-12-04

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording of a dark‑star‑heavy show featuring Black Peter, Uncle John’s Band and a stellar Pigpen performance
ai_review.review: The concert is praised for its powerful Dark Star > High Time sequence, standout renditions of Black Peter and Uncle John’s Band, and an especially inspired Pigpen showing up at the Fillmore West. While reviewers don’t comment on audio specifics, the .sbd source suggests a clean soundboard capture that lets the strong musical moments shine.

ai_rating.rationale: Three reviews (two 5‑star, one neutral) highlight excellent performance and no noted recording flaws; weighted average of show (70%) and presumed solid soundboard quality (30%) yields a high rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No explicit comments on audio clarity; filename indicates a soundboard source, which is typically clear and balanced.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong second‑half momentum with a smoking Dark Star segue into High Time, rounded out by emotive Black Peter and uplifting Uncle John’s Band.

band_member_comments.Keys: Pigpen shines on this night, delivering great organ/harmonica work and memorable vocal moments.
